reviews.title: I was nervous unnecessarily
reviews.text: This was my first time using this small airline. Before boarding I was told they were strict with luggage allowance. Knowing my luggage was 2 pounds overweight I was bit nervous .However, on checking the attendants were not the bit fussy about the extra pounds. The airline was on time, and provided excellent service. For a small aircraft legroom was good and service was excellent . I will use this airline in the future.
reviews.author: Coryy20

reviews.title: Do not fly on Luxair from London City Airport!
reviews.text: Luxair used old airplanes lacking modern navigational tools. I sat for ten hours at London City Airport in January experiencing three diverted/cancelled Luxair flights while BA, KLM and Lufthansa flights were landing and taking off normally, missing my connection in Luxembourg. Luxair has refused me any compensation for this in spite of their ground staff giving me OK to take a taxi to my destination.
reviews.author: Per A J

reviews.title: Flying back to Luxembourg instead of having holiday
reviews.text: Luxair Flight 773 couldn't land in Madeira due to strong winds. This isn't the fault of the company. However, communication about the next steps could have been better. We stayed one night in Porto Santo and the next day we flew back to Luxembourg. There is free Wifi Entertainment on board, but unfortunately this didn't work the whole flight.
reviews.author: Lucilin

reviews.title: Amateurs, bad booking system, expensive and amateur
reviews.text: I paid 424 Euro for an economy flight on a small crappy plane. I decided I didn’t want anyone beside me so I paid an additional 45. I got a receipt and was assigned seat 5 C and the one next to it. I checked in online and was given seat 17C. I called client support. They told me that I still had those seats and they would be given to me at the airport. Not so ! We are sorry. They couldn’t do anything. Called a manager who was less than willing to do anything. I was advised to contact client support upon my return. Almost 500€ for an economy flight on a crap twin engine plane. I mean it I will never fly Luxair again and u like a lot of other people who just shout it, I mean it. Never again.
reviews.author: r a p h a ë L S

reviews.title: No value for money - useless customer service
reviews.text: My experience with Luxair is limited, but for me already enough! Their flights are extremely overpriced and while one would therefore expect a good service for it, it is not at all the case. I am coeliac (cannot eat gluten for a medical condition) and after paying about 250 euros per flight in economy class, I contacted the customer service asking for replacing the usual snack that they would offer on board for a gluten free snack. Their answer was that on short-distance flights (2h 30) it is not part of their policy to replace snacks and that the customer can bring his own. Unbeliavable! They even recommended me not to eat the snack that they would give me on board, that it is not worth to be sick for a snack. I was even more shocked by this comment. The only alternative would have been to pay 30 additional euros (15 per flight) to get a full gluten free meal. I cannot believe that after paying 500 euros for a round trip it is not possible to get a 2-euros worth gluten free snack. I hope that this ridiculous policy can be updated.
reviews.author: Gio

reviews.title: Bad Airline
reviews.text: Old Aircraft, Cancellation, Rebooked to a super packed flight, more delays and poor customer service. Day wasted thank you Luxair.
reviews.author: Jon

reviews.title: Great journeys.
reviews.text: I used this airline for day trip to Luxembourg as their timings were the most suitable . This airline is one I would be proud to have as my flag carrier. The flight is very quick but you get a croissant for breakfast and juice for free and sandwich and wine or soft drinks on the pay back . You also get a sweet before landing. I would hesitate to take this airline for longer trips in the future.
reviews.author: Crimsondream

reviews.title: Terrible Customer Service, poor service overall
reviews.text: LuxAir is, by far, one of the worst airlines that I had traveled with. The level of ignorance representatives have for the customers is not something that can be met often. Aircraft I was in was so small and cramped that a person like me, 50kg, is feeling quite calustrophobic. Meals on board were, actually, nice. The flight was relatively short, but still, aircraft on the return was FULL and space between the seats preety much doesn't exist. Besides that, LuxAir managed to take money off my account somehow by mistake and never provided an explanation or an answer why they charged me. Just like that. Customer service is TERRIBLE! The only way to contact them if you are living outside of Luxembourg area and if you don't want to be charged a lot for a phone call is via website - you open a ticket and they reach out to you via e-mail. I waited FOR DAYS to be reached out for complaint I submitted and even then they weren't responding accordingly or responded very poorly. Had to send follow ups multiple times. Outcome - took money off my account, told me I had to wait for 4-6 weeks for a refund, never explained why that happend, refunded me after 2 weeks with less amount they took in the first place. Were rude enough to close a ticket like it was resolved. Do not recommend at all.
reviews.author: Tamara O

reviews.title: Worst than Ryanair
reviews.text: The check in service is below any acceptable. Booked a flight and the luggage and “The Manager” (aka a supervisor) demanded I pay 60 euro as she could not see that on her system. I could prove the clear “check in luggage “ purchase- still it was my problem her system was faulty. Zero willingness to look into, zero ability to resolve the issue. Will avoid this company!
reviews.author: Juju

reviews.title: More like a XXth century charter
reviews.text: I was disappointed by this flight by an airline I otherwise like. But I liked the direct flight sparing us the hassle of a connection. There was no online check-in available and there was no way of selecting seats beforehand due to an unknown error in the system. So we (family of three) ended up in the row 28, last one in the plane. Not recommended as being back-to-back to the lavatories. Check-in in Luxembourg was otherwise OK. Inside the plane, no ife despite there was advertisement for one over the WiFi. It didn't work. The Boeing was clearly an old machine. For this 5 hour flight, only a meager cold bf was proposed. Hostesses were very kind nonetheless, thanks. We arrived in time at destination, good.
reviews.author: Jean R

reviews.title: Last minute cancellation
reviews.text: They cancelled the flight while we were in the bus travelling to the airport! The only flight that was cancelled...The reason given was "operational reasons". Personnel at the guichet 17 was plainly indifferent, even smirking at times, at seeing frustration on peoples faces... they even gave people false instructions (they said, call luxair center- who told people to go ask at guichet 17). We had to rush to get rebooked, others had to be rebooked for the next day! They said we are not eligible for indemnization, even the link to a coupon for lunch on their site was inactive... they told us to make a photo of the meal receipt and try to get back 11 euros pp
reviews.author: Asteroskoni

reviews.title: Misserable airliner
reviews.text: Was flying from Washington DC on a Star Alliance flight, first class, and had checked 3 pieces of language. Connected in FRA and landed in LUX airport with one piece of language missing. The same morning I arrived back at LUX had to go back and forth two more times because the lost luggage web form was not working for LUX airport (the best kept secrete at LUX airport) so i had to go back and file the form. Third trip, I was forced to go back because even though the luggage had arrived, they could not deliver on Saturday, nor Sunday and Monday was a national holiday so no service either. The earliest would have been Tuesday (as the manager told me, he would be doing me a favor). Other airliners do deliver delayed language (Lufthansa delivered one after to another country than my original destination as a customer service). In another instance, I boarded my inbound to LUX flight on a wheelchair. Clearly, the flight crew had seen me boarding but upon arrival in LUX airport there was no wheelchair waiting. Everybody has disembarked and the crew waited with me for about 45 min will eventually ground services provided me with a wheelchair. LuxAir- most likely an oligopoly-charges an arm and a leg for no service. I am trying to avoid flying with this airliner (one ground crew once told me straight into my face: "so if you don't like Luxair why do you fly with us?") and consider even driving to FRA to avoid having to deal with them.
reviews.author: LuXAirDisgruntledPAX

reviews.title: Customer support and Customer relations
reviews.text: The booking process was good. Very quick handling. Our flight was 9 hours delayed. Lost baggage. No voucher for food worked. We where told to send in recites to be refunded but no response to that after 2 weeks.
reviews.author: Exploration317497

reviews.title: Rude and unhelpful
reviews.text: I drove from France to Luxembourg to check in the night before my flight as I was in a wheelchair. We arrived at the Lux Air desk but they would not let me pay for my bag as their cashier desk was closed. I asked the manager if she could make an exception for one bag as we had driven from France. She said technically she could check the bag but would not do it for me because she didn’t want to explain it to her manager. I went home with my bag and returned again the next day. It was early so the bag check staff wasn’t there. After 45 minutes I feared missing my flight and asked what could be done to check the bag. They told me rudely that I had not waited 45 minutes and the staff were busy working. Of course they lost the bag. It took 4 days to get it. I asked for compensation but they quoted a law that basically means it’s not their fault.
reviews.author: Toni S

reviews.title: How are the mighty fallen
reviews.text: In the good old days of 727 you could tell the luxair flights landing in Palma because the passengers zig zagged their way across the concourse to the airport building. The stewardesses always said "Would you like Brandy or Whisky with your breakfast coffee," and they served quadruples. No way you could have a gin and tonic as there was no place for the tonic! On the last flight it was red wine. White wine or tomatoe juice or fizz. The old days were much more fun
reviews.author: rentsh

reviews.title: Not worth it
reviews.text: Do we have to explain to the compagny that wearing masks isn’t useful in the plane anymore, essentially when they don’t ask us to wear it before, in the waiting line for the checking ? Live with your time, stop annoying your passengers… Otherwise, food is okay, well done 👏🏻 But still don’t like you. With pleasure, Me.
reviews.author: Juliette RC
reviews.route: Luxembourg - Las Palmas de Gran Canaria

reviews.title: Poor customer service when problems occur
reviews.text: When you claim a reimbursement or a voucher after severe delays Luxair announces 14 days treatment but it is now 42 days that we are waiting - 200% more time and the service center says we cannot talk to anyone for claims.and nobody ever answers emails. very low level of client service when problems occur. At minimum the company should do the maximum to compensate for painful customer experiences in a smooth way - improvements clearly needed.
reviews.author: Val

reviews.title: Very rude!!
reviews.text: Very bad experience, the low cost of the flight is not worth the trouble!!! Better served elsewhere!
reviews.author: Daniil G

reviews.title: Airline cancellation policy and false advertisement
reviews.text: I booked a return flight with this airline from Luxembourg to London. I was unable to get on the first leg of the flight as the uk passenger locator form was malfunctioning. I was advised I was unable to get on the flight and suggested I would try the next day with Ryanair. I was not informed that the return leg of my flight would definitely be cancelled at this point. I travelled to London with Ryanair instead and planned to return with Luxair. However when checking in for the return leg, the checkin staff told me the ticket was cancelled. I was not aware of this as one expects a cancellation email and instead I received an email to upgrade the same day (false advertising when they had cancelled my flight). Eventually they did provide me with a place on the flight after 40 minutes of the checkin staff doing their best for me and a fine that I had to pay. If I pay money for a flight, should I not receive a cancellation email? It’s possible to book with other airlines if this is done. Also how is it legal that I can be offered an upgrade on a flight that Luxair have secretly cancelled. I’ve flown with other airlines and never suffered this bad treatment. I would not recommend this airline when travelling especially during a pandemic when they should try to be encouraging people to travel with them.
reviews.author: Conor R

reviews.title: Beware LUXAIR marketing flights on on-line sites...
reviews.text: ... if anything goes wrong, each side will disclaim responsibility & you have no recourse. We bought LUXAIR flights on Expedia in November, making absolutely sure that a checked bag on both outward & return journeys was included ( who with any experience of RYANAIR would not ? ) When we showed at London City for the return journey we were told that checked baggage was not included ( " LUXAIR's rules " ! ) & we were obliged to pay EUR 50 for each checked bag. When Expedia asked for feedback on the trip I complained about this : there was predictably no reply. I complained to LUXAIR as a long-term customer : in their honeyed reply they hinted at a " misunderstanding " on my part with Expedia. Caveat emptor. Your money may be extracted from you to pay for all their empty seats in 2020/2021.
reviews.author: fairdos

reviews.title: Flight changed by Luxair...totally inflexible
reviews.text: Luxair changed my daughters flight....from evening to mid working day. She had to call in to alter...no online option......they gave her 1 flight choice. After the call she realised she had a meeting at that same time so called back to change it. The Luxair person told her she had already spent an hour changing her flight and that my daughter had to pay a fee plus the difference in the flight cost, my daughter reiterated that it was Luxair that changed the flight originally ....the luxair person then shouted at her "we dont have time to change your flight 100 times and we want to eat something at the end of the month too". They were utterly rude and insulting. My daughter said she wanted to make an official complaint. The person then said " yeah you can...go online ". No way will we fly with this airline again....but their reaction is that they really don't care.
reviews.author: Lorraine00053

reviews.title: Horrendous Customer Service
reviews.text: The website is horrendously under-equipped for any COVID enquiries. They have about 4 lines and NO information about how to cancel, refund or change your booking. I used an agent to book and they wont speak to me directly, the agent contacted them with no reply. Absolutely SHOCKING. DO NOT USE! They are proffiting from a global pandemic and it is disgusting. Id rather use RYAN AIR than this lot, and they are horrendous too. Load of theiving criminals.
reviews.author: Dom E

reviews.title: Not equipped for long haul flights but arrival/departure times are great
reviews.text: ** This review does not reflect my assessment of 1-2 hr flights using Luxair which I find is excellent/better than average** I'm accustomed to flying with Swiss to DXB via ZRH but given the opportunity to fly direct from Luxembourg, I thought I'd give it a shot. Pros - Arrival time in DXB is much earlier than with Swiss or Lufthansa which means you get through passport control much faster and can arrive at your hotel in time to still enjoy dinner at a restaurant (Tip - Going with Marhaba service means little to no wait time through passport control but I'd save that for later arrival times when flying via Swiss/Lufthansa). The major advantage is on the way back given you don't leave until 11:30 in the morning which means you are able to enjoy a restful night sleep versus flying in the middle of the night with Swiss/Lufthansa. Cons - The aircraft used is absolutely not equipped for long haul travel. I travelled business on the way to DXB and travelled via economy on the way back. Difference? Food/drinks and that is it. Flight time is 6.5-7 hours and there is no inflight entertainment and no in seat charging capability - budget travel at its best except you pay what you would if flying Swiss/Lufthansa which at least has the basic necessities related to travelling this century... Bottom line - Business class from LUX - DXB is a joke so don't pay the extra money for it, even if the flight crew were great :) Go with Luxair only if you are fully prepared to entertain yourself the e
reviews.author: B N

reviews.title: CEO
reviews.text: Would NOT recommend the business class to Dubai with lux air, it's more an economy plus, nothing like business class at all. Don't spend the extra money for it definitely not worth it. Shame.theybare selling those as "business class ticket".
reviews.author: steve b

reviews.title: Luxair review
reviews.text: The airline has offered excellent service for years, but now it all crumbles because of their practices, milking the customers and destroying their brand. My flight has been rescheduled and i was given the option to switch the flight to an other or get a refund. It was not mentioned that this right would dissapear several days before rhe flight and they offered me to play an additional amount of 135€ to get an other flight. I accepted and was asked the card number via telephone which is already unsafe to begin with. On the day of the departure, I get notified that the flight is delayed and I plan to spend a longer time outside the airport. When I tried the check-in, I was notified that the plane boarded already and that the people from the airport didn't have the ability to refund or change the flight, because luxair does not give them permission. Any explanation, why I got an email and an sms of the apparently not delayed flight could not be given. So at 9 in the evening i tried calling luxair, but the service is closed at that time. Following day, I get trough the never ending music and get some employee on the phone. They only thing he said is that he can not do anything about that and that I should write an email. No refund or explanation so far.
reviews.author: Alex D.

reviews.title: Sub-standard airline; low business sense management team; location advantage
reviews.text: The service they offer is average at best, but I am grateful that they now have a Luxembourg to Dubai direct flight. However, I was stupefied at some of their business policies. I wanted to change my flight date to an earlier date, and add baggage capacity, so I thought to upgrade my flight to business class (free date changes, 2 x 32 kg bags). I placed a bid on their smart upgrade page, and waited a month with no response (they are not obligated to respond up to 3 days before your flight), so I raised requests to contact them via their website, but never heard back. When I called customer service (no local UAE numbers, so it has to be an international call where you are on hold for at least 10 minutes), I was told that the only way to upgrade was through the smart upgrade form, which makes no business sense and completely defeats my purpose. So now I have to wait and hope that someone from their customer service team reads my request and responds, which going by history doesn't look good as they have never ever responded to me. They're actually turning down customers who are willing to pay to upgrade! If you have stock in this airline, I'd sell :-)
reviews.author: Prash

reviews.title: Rookie airlines
reviews.text: Clearly they are not equipped for 6-7 hours flight. Even flying in business class the flight was a disaster, no infotainment, no possibility of charging any device, no onboard WiFi. The cabin crew took the liberty of disappear after the first service, no ice for drinks, no pillows no blankets. It simply wasn’t up to any standard for long flight! That was just miserable.
reviews.author: Michele T

reviews.title: Probably worst airline service in Europe
reviews.text: Terrible, avoid if possible. High prices - only for being based in Luxembourg and providing you cookies on the flight Old airplanes - how many of them receive European authorisation to fly? They were probably already in use 60 years ago Low reliability - flights paid and cancelled with no similar replacement within 24h or at similar time after 24h from the original schedule (should I pay hotels and taxies because they can’t operate their business as they are paid for?) Luggages lost - flying with luxair means high probability of luggages lost with no chance of having it delivered at your place in a scheduled time but you having to go at their place at their requested time to pick it up (outrageous)
reviews.author: Lorenzo

reviews.title: Flight cancelled after five minutes from the booking
reviews.text: The cancelled my flight after 5 minutes i paid them, and the customer service was conpletely useless. It could take now three months to get a reimboursment, did not expect this from a the Luxembourg national airline
reviews.author: Amin H

reviews.title: Expensive - but safe
reviews.text: It is an expensive airline. Due to Covid I decided to book my holiday with Luxair Tours. This was a good deal since it included the flights, hotel and transfers. Unfortunately, you don't get the miles when booking this way. On my return flight I got a row to myself. On the flight to Crete I was put next to a couple, which did not make sense. This might have been because passengers weren't able to check-in online since Luxair had to check the form passengers needed to fill in before their flights to Greece. Fortunately, I was able to change seats and got a row to myself. They didn't hand out newspapers or in flight magazines due to Covid but you could download the magazine. Passengers were only allowed to take off their masks for 15 minutes during the meal. The airline also provided a mask, a towelette, sanitary gel and a little trash bag. Flight attendants were also keeping an eye out for passengers, who did not cover their noses and mouths. That made me feel safe.
reviews.author: keeweeset
